nodes.description: Mendel.cost: mint price per token (0.18 ether) used in payment checks.
Mendel.publicSupplyMinted: counter of public/presale mints, incremented after mint loops.
Mendel.teamMintSupplyMinted: counter of team mints used in supply checks.
Mendel.maxMintSupply: global cap on total minted tokens.
Mendel.publicMaxSupply: cap for public/whitelist mints.
Mendel.whitelist mapping(address=>uint256): per-address presale mint allowance.
Mendel.teamWhitelist mapping(address=>uint256): per-address team mint allowance.
Mendel.isPublicSaleActive: gate flag for the public mint function.
Mendel.isPresaleActive: gate flag for the presale mint function.
Mendel.isTeamMintActive: gate flag for the team mint function.
Mendel.presaleDay: owner-set day selector altering presale allowance logic.
Mendel.baseURI: prefix used when building token URIs.
Mendel.teamMintMaxSupply: cap on team minted tokens.
Mendel.maxMintAmount: per-transaction mint limit.
Mendel.mint(uint256): payable public mint, loops nextToken()/_safeMint and updates publicSupplyMinted.
Mendel.presaleMint(uint256): payable whitelist mint, manipulates senderLimit locally and rewrites whitelist[msg.sender].
Mendel.teamMint(uint256): payable team mint, consumes teamWhitelist[msg.sender] allowance.
Mendel.withdraw(): onlyOwner, sends entire contract balance to msg.sender via low-level send.
Mendel.setBaseURI(string): onlyOwner setter for baseURI.
Mendel.addWhitelist(address[],uint256[]): onlyOwner bulk writes to whitelist.
Mendel.addTeamMintWhitelist(address[],uint256[]): onlyOwner bulk writes to teamWhitelist.
Mendel.changeCost(uint256): onlyOwner setter for the mint cost.
Mendel.togglePublicSaleStatus(): onlyOwner flip of isPublicSaleActive.
Mendel.togglePresaleStatus(): onlyOwner flip of isPresaleActive.
Mendel.toggleTeamMintStatus(): onlyOwner flip of isTeamMintActive.
Mendel.mintDay(uint256): onlyOwner setter for presaleDay.
Mendel.walletOfOwner(address): view enumerator returning owned token ids.
Mendel.tokenURI(uint256): view metadata builder concatenating baseURI and token id.
Caller-controlled address used as whitelist key, mint recipient and withdraw destination.

Low-level ETH send in withdraw that transfers control to msg.sender.
External callback to IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received executed during minting loops.

edges.reason: msg.sender (_msgSender) is the recipient address of every token minted in the mint loop.
msg.sender is used to index whitelist and to persist the reduced allowance, making the allowance caller-dependent.
msg.sender indexes teamWhitelist and receives the minted tokens.
msg.sender is the destination of the full balance transfer in withdraw.
block.timestamp is hashed into the token index randomness, making it miner/timestamp dependent.
whitelist state is read to derive senderLimit and rewritten after minting.
teamWhitelist state is read to derive senderLimit and rewritten after minting.
cost drives the msg.value >= cost * _mintAmount payment requirement.
cost drives the presale payment requirement.
publicSupplyMinted participates in additive supply checks and is incremented by _mintAmount.
publicSupplyMinted is checked and incremented in presaleMint.
publicSupplyMinted is added to teamMintSupplyMinted and _mintAmount in the supply check.
teamMintSupplyMinted is summed with publicSupplyMinted and _mintAmount against maxMintSupply.
teamMintSupplyMinted is compared against teamMintMaxSupply and then incremented.
maxMintSupply bounds the additive supply expression in mint.
publicMaxSupply bounds publicSupplyMinted + _mintAmount in mint.
teamMintMaxSupply bounds teamMintSupplyMinted + _mintAmount.
maxMintAmount caps the caller-supplied _mintAmount.
isPublicSaleActive must be true before mint can execute.
isPresaleActive gates execution of presaleMint.
isTeamMintActive gates execution of teamMint.
presaleDay selects between the two senderLimit adjustment branches in presaleMint.
togglePublicSaleStatus flips isPublicSaleActive and is restricted to the owner.
togglePresaleStatus flips isPresaleActive and is restricted to the owner.
toggleTeamMintStatus flips isTeamMintActive and is restricted to the owner.
mintDay overwrites presaleDay, indirectly changing presale allowance rules.
changeCost overwrites cost, changing the payment requirement for mints.
setBaseURI overwrites baseURI used by tokenURI.
addWhitelist writes per-address presale allowances into whitelist.
addTeamMintWhitelist writes per-address allowances into teamWhitelist.
mint parameter _mintAmount bounds the loop and the supply increments.
presaleMint parameter _mintAmount bounds the loop and is compared to senderLimit.
teamMint parameter _mintAmount bounds the loop and is compared to senderLimit.
local senderLimit is decremented in the loop and written back to whitelist.
local senderLimit is decremented in the loop and written back to teamWhitelist.
mintIndex returned by nextToken is passed into the external _safeMint callback.
mintIndex in presaleMint is passed into the external _safeMint callback.
mintIndex in teamMint is passed into the external _safeMint callback.
mint invokes _safeMint which performs an external call to onERC721Received.
presaleMint invokes _safeMint inside the loop before whitelist and supply counters are finalised.
teamMint invokes _safeMint inside the loop before teamWhitelist is rewritten.
A malicious recipient contract can re-enter mint from onERC721Received while publicSupplyMinted is stale.
A malicious recipient can re-enter presaleMint from onERC721Received before whitelist[msg.sender] is updated.
A malicious recipient can re-enter teamMint from onERC721Received before teamWhitelist[msg.sender] is updated.
withdraw performs a low-level send that hands control to the recipient.
The recipient of the low-level send can re-enter withdraw/owner paths before state settles.
